sloka: इदमुक्तवती देवी जानकी पुरुषर्षभ ।पूर्ववृत्तमभिज्ञानं चित्रकूटे यथातथम् ।। ५.६७.२ ।।।।
transliteration: idamuktavatī devī jānakī puruṣarṣabha ।pūrvavṛttamabhijñānaṁ citrakūṭe yathātatham ।। 5.67.2 ।।।।

translations.english: "O bull among men queen Janaki related to me as a token of identification an incident that had taken place at Chitrakuta in the past.
